name: obs_reward
description: Salazar's version against ours, two by two: reward (the original code's, or the net bill) by observation (the paper's 42 signals, or the pruned 22) on 1-LV-rural3--2-sw with 13 participants, the settings of scale_p13, on German 2024 prices (config/data/de_2024.json) with no peer charge. Grid capacity 400 kWh per step: the transformer's 0.4 MVA over one hour. The arms share the PPO settings. Compare them on the held-out bill (heldout_agents.csv), not on their returns: those are in each reward's own units, and the salazar reward rewards trading more than money, so random actions beat net_position on it while losing money.
